service.description: MCP server/discover: protocol versions and capabilities (MCP revision 2026-07-28 requires every server to implement this). ttlMs/cacheScope are required fields of DiscoverResult; cacheScope is public because the answer is the same for every caller.

Legacy-era MCP initialize (pre-2026 stateful protocol), served for backward compatibility under the 2026-07-28 spec's MAY clause for headerless clients — the claude CLI still leads with this handshake. Echoes the client's requested protocolVersion (tools/list and tools/call are wire-compatible); mints no session (sessions were optional in the legacy revisions) and offers no SSE stream (GET on the endpoint returns 405, also legal then).

actions.script: String compVersion = 'unknown' try { compVersion = ec.factory.componentInfoMap?.get('moqui-ai')?.version ?: 'unknown' } catch (Throwable t) {} result = [protocolVersion: (params?.get('protocolVersion') ?: '2025-06-18'), capabilities: [tools: [listChanged: false]], serverInfo: [name: 'moqui-ai', version: compVersion]]

service.description: MCP tools/list: the catalog in wire form. Deterministic order (sorted by name) so clients and model prompt caches can rely on it. ttlMs/cacheScope are required fields of ListToolsResult; cacheScope is public because the list is not filtered by caller (design decision 9). Internal catalog fields (serviceName, fixedParameters) never reach the wire.

actions.script: List wire = [] for (Map t in (List<Map>) catOut.toolList) { Map w = [name: t.name, description: t.description, inputSchema: t.inputSchema, outputSchema: t.outputSchema] if (t.annotations) w.annotations = t.annotations if (t.title) w.title = t.title wire.add(w) } result = [tools: wire, ttlMs: 300000, cacheScope: 'public']

service.description: MCP tools/call: resolve the named tool in the catalog and execute it. An unknown tool name is a protocol error (-32602, returned via the error out-parameter for the engine to envelope); a tool that runs but fails reports inside the result with isError:true, per the MCP error split.
